events.summary: Atraxa tells an opponent that even his blade knows who will triumph.
events.quote: Even your blade knows who will triumph here.

events.summary: Ludevic exults over his creation coming to life.
events.quote: It lives . . . IT LIVES!

events.summary: Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire in the Cursemute.
events.quote: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

events.summary: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours and now carry it across Innistrad.
events.quote: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours.

events.summary: Thalia says holy places are no longer sanctuary from death.
events.quote: Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything.

events.summary: Slag-workers cleanse the area of the incompleat.
events.quote: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

events.summary: Elesh Norn celebrates that the glorious infection has taken hold.
events.quote: Our glorious infection has taken hold.

events.summary: The oil created the mycosynth, which created New Phyrexia.
events.quote: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Zurgo, khan of the Mardu, tells a challenger he found only a weak opponent.
events.quote: I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you.

events.summary: Ikra Shidiqi declares the scaled ones now rule Tarkir.
events.quote: Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir.

events.summary: Jor Kadeen hopes for a pure Mirrodin once again.
events.quote: there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again.

events.summary: Koth recalls the purity of Mirrodin-that-was in darksteel.
events.quote: It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was.

events.summary: Glissa recalls Slobad was exiled for being too smart.
events.quote: I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart.

events.summary: Kiora says people will worship anyone who answers their pleas when gods grow apathetic.
events.quote: the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas.

events.summary: Tezzeret says etherium is limited and innovation is not.
events.quote: Etherium is limited. Innovation is not.

events.summary: Houn tells a former Mardu that his mind must now be trained.
events.quote: You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong.

events.summary: Dravin recalls dropping his sword and weeping at the idiocy of war after seeing the Blazing Archon.
events.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.

events.summary: Kydele bears the burden of knowing.
events.quote: She bears the greatest burden of all: that of knowing.

events.summary: Kynaios and Tiro recall what they fought for and built together.
events.quote: Look what we fought for. Look what we built together.

events.summary: Sorin's enemies fall victim to his path.
events.quote: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

events.summary: Melira says Phyrexians cannot imbue a weapon with part of a soul.
events.quote: something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing.

relations.note: Elesh Norn speaks of the infection as glorious.
relations.quote: Our glorious infection has taken hold.
Even your blade knows who will triumph here.

relations.note: Melira contrasts the sylvok crafters with Phyrexians.
relations.quote: something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing.

relations.note: Zurgo is khan of the Mardu.
relations.quote: I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you.
Now we must train your mind.
